description: The stored figures for one ticker, one row per metric and period, each with its period (fy, fp), period end, filing date and form. Use it for trends and for what was on file at a past date. Inputs: ticker, metric (comma-separated), from (earliest period end), as_of (only filings dated on or before that day). On a free key, a company outside the full-history sample answers with its most recent reported fiscal year only: full_history false and history_depth say so, and older filings exist. Long histories are capped at 250 rows, keeping the most recent rows of EVERY metric (per_metric says how many of each); narrow with metric/from for the rest. Before using the figures: they are as filed, each keyed to its filing date (`filed`) as its market records it (how each market dates a filing: https://www.tradingagentapp.com/fundamentals/methodology). .TW quarterly values are already SINGLE-QUARTER amounts: do not difference adjacent quarters. For a quarterly row (US, Taiwan) fy and fp are the CALENDAR quarter containing the period end, not the company's fiscal quarter. Each reply's `market_notes` and `schema` give the per-market caveats (solo or group accounts, lawful gaps, charities, flags in `form`); read them before interpreting a figure. Detailed line items follow local accounting rules and keep the filed sign (capex is negative in Taiwan and Japan): call get_data_dictionary before comparing them across markets. When you relay figures, keep the reply's `attribution` and `licence` notices with them.

as_of.description: Filing-date cut-off, YYYY-MM-DD: only filings dated on or before that day

from.description: Earliest period end to include, YYYY-MM-DD
